bar: Scanning this corpus must yield zero findings. See README.md, 'The bar'.

fixtures.name: api-weather-fetch
fixtures.trap: Uses an HTTP client and declares that use in the frontmatter description and allowed-tools. Network primitives alone are never a finding.

fixtures.name: ssh-key-manager
fixtures.trap: Touches the SSH configuration directory, and key management is its declared purpose, so the credential-path rule is suppressed. No egress primitive is present.

fixtures.name: security-review-docs
fixtures.trap: Its prose quotes attacker phrasings while teaching reviewers to spot them. Metadata rules must be restricted to description and tool-metadata fields, not README prose.

fixtures.name: static-site-deploy
fixtures.trap: Recursive removal scoped to a scratch directory the script created under TMPDIR. Scoped cleanup is not a destructive command.

fixtures.name: localhost-metrics
fixtures.trap: Claims to run locally and does contact an HTTP endpoint, but only on the loopback interface, which the mismatch rule exempts.

fixtures.name: markdown-table-formatter
fixtures.trap: Baseline ordinary formatting skill. Any finding here means the engine is broken.

fixtures.name: mcp-config-standard
fixtures.trap: Package-manager launches of named, version-pinned MCP servers are the ecosystem norm and must not fire the MCP runtime rule. No credential values in any env block.

fixtures.name: hook-local-formatter
fixtures.trap: A hook that shells out to a local formatter. Hook strings get the full byte-rule pass but contain no egress primitive.

fixtures.name: settings-with-permissions
fixtures.trap: A user's own settings file legitimately contains a permission allow-list. The auto-approve rule targets bundle content that writes one, not a settings file that has one.

fixtures.name: plugin-home
fixtures.trap: An installed marketplace plugin with a skill, a command and a local hook. Plugin discovery must not itself generate findings.

fixtures.name: home-user-skills
fixtures.trap: User-level skills, commands and agents with entirely ordinary content.

fixtures.name: docs-install-oneliner
fixtures.trap: README, CHANGELOG, CONTRIBUTING and docs/DESIGN.md quote the official curl|bash and Homebrew installer one-liners, a self-install cp into ~/.claude/skills, a symlink into .claude/skills and the --dangerously-skip-permissions flag. Documentation is not an execution surface: behaviour rules fire only from EXECUTABLE and INSTRUCTION files.

fixtures.name: test-suite-injection-strings
fixtures.trap: Injection-hardening tests whose fixtures are literal 'rm -rf /', 'curl | bash', base64-to-shell and settings-redirect payloads, in both test/ and tests/ and in both *.test.ts and test_*.py spellings. Test material is not behaviour.

fixtures.name: localhost-only-diagram
fixtures.trap: Claims to work offline and does contact HTTP endpoints, but only loopback ones written WITHOUT a URL scheme ('curl localhost:3000', '127.0.0.1:8787/health', '[::1]:8787'). The blueprint's localhost exemption has to survive the spelling everybody actually uses.
